metadata.benchmark_note: Manual benchmark snapshot used for comparison.

player_market_gap_weeks.selection_basis: Week 6 top fifteen reconstructed on October 19 from the saved pregame player feeds and FanDuel screenshot lines entered October 16. The cutoff was expanded after play at user request; it was not independently locked before play. Future weeks use a pregame top-fifteen lock.
player_market_gap_weeks.ranking_rule: Absolute gap descending; ties by player name, then player ID. Zero gaps and missing line/projection excluded. One primary statistic per player.
player_market_gap_weeks.primary_stats: QB passing yards; RB rushing yards; WR/TE receiving yards.

summary.units_basis: One unit risked per selection; net profit at the recorded price for the projected side. Pending results excluded; pushes/voids return the stake.

player_market_gap_snapshot_history.reason: Week 6 expanded retrospectively from ten to fifteen at user request. Original snapshot preserved.
